about.method: NODAL Screen shows measurements from a short movement protocol: a 10 m walk, Timed Up and Go, five times sit-to-stand, and single-leg stance. Children also do a tandem walk and a hop. A clinician reviews each flag and chooses the pathway.
about.assumptions: Reference values come from the sources below. Reference values marked placeholder are pending verification. Complementary suppression is not applied.
about.limitations: The product measures and flags. It is not yet validated. Every person in this prototype is synthetic. Review decisions stay in this browser. A letter drafted from the measurements is not sent until a clinician approves it.
